facts.fact: Simone 播出紧急天气警报（urgent weather advisory）。
facts.anchor: This is Simone with an urgent weather advisory.

facts.fact: 强冷锋南下逼近 Keys，将再触发一场强雷暴，气象报告称移动速度很快。
facts.anchor: A powerful cold front is moving down toward the Keys and will trigger another severe thunderstorm.

facts.fact: Paradise 正处在风暴路径上，度假村正在为风暴登陆做预案。
facts.anchor: Paradise is in the path of the storm, and we are preparing for when it makes landfall.

facts.fact: 要求所有客人立刻到 Welcome Center 集合——全家会合、就地避难（shelter in place）。
facts.anchor: We request that all guests report to the Welcome Center immediately, so families can meet and shelter in place together.

facts.fact: Lookouts 与 counselors 将主导本次行动，要求客人严格、有序地服从指令。
facts.anchor: Lookouts and counselors will be leading this operation, so please follow their instructions very carefully and in an orderly fashion.
